#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>
#include <regex>
#include <vector>

using namespace std;

int countTokens(const string& str, char delim) {
    if (str.empty()) return 0;
    stringstream ss(str);
    string token;
    int cnt = 0;
    while (getline(ss, token, delim)) {
        if (!token.empty()) cnt++;
    }
    return cnt;
}

int main() {
    int n;
    string s;
    cin >> n >> s;
    int winpars = 0, longest = 0;
    int i = 0, j = 0;

    // Replace all "__" with "_" repeatedly
    while (s.find("__") != string::npos) {
        size_t pos = s.find("__");
        while (pos != string::npos) {
            s.replace(pos, 2, "_");
            pos = s.find("__", pos);
        }
    }

    n = s.length();

    // First if: check if first character is '('
    if (i < n && s[i] == '(') {
        while (j < n && s[j++] != ')') {
            // empty body, j increments in condition
        }
        if (j < n && s[j] == ')') {
            string temp = s.substr(i + 1, j - i - 1);
            if (temp.find('_') == string::npos && temp.length() > 0) {
                ++winpars;
            } else {
                winpars += countTokens(temp, '_');
            }
            i = j;
        }
    }

    // Second while: process remaining parentheses
    while (i < n && s[i] != '(') {
        ++i;
        if (i < n && s[i] == '(') {
            j = i;
            while (j < n && s[j++] != ')') {
                // empty body
            }
            if (j < n && s[j] == ')') {
                string temp = s.substr(i + 1, j - i - 1);
                if (temp.find('_') == string::npos && temp.length() > 0) {
                    ++winpars;
                } else {
                    winpars += countTokens(temp, '_');
                }
                i = j;
            }
        }
    }

    // Replace all parenthesized groups with "_"
    regex paren_regex(R"(\([^\(]*\))");
    while (s.find('(') != string::npos || s.find(')') != string::npos) {
        s = regex_replace(s, paren_regex, "_");
    }

    // Tokenize by '_' and find longest token
    stringstream ss(s);
    string token;
    while (getline(ss, token, '_')) {
        if (token.length() > longest) {
            longest = token.length();
        }
    }

    cout << longest << " " << winpars << endl;
    return 0;
}
